original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿韦尔妇女领袖承诺打击强迫婚姻与早婚
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹北加扎勒河州阿韦尔中心县妇女协会新当选主席阿布克·阿齐贝尔·安达尔承诺，将开展反对强迫婚姻、早婚和性别暴力的运动。她表示女孩应继续留在学校接受教育，并呼吁家长不要因怀孕或经济困难迫使女孩结婚。当地活动人士称，经济状况恶化正导致强迫婚姻和早婚现象增多。

location.raw_text: Aweil Centre County, Northern Bahr el Ghazal State

key_facts.fact: 阿韦尔中心县妇女协会新当选主席承诺打击强迫婚姻和早婚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The newly elected chairperson of the women’s association in Aweil Centre County, Northern Bahr el Ghazal State, has pledged to campaign against forced and early marriages and gender-based violence.

key_facts.fact: 安达尔于周三当选，她表示女孩应继续接受教育
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Abuk Aziber Andal was elected on Wednesday during polls organised by the Northern Bahr el Ghazal State General Women’s Association.

key_facts.fact: 当地活动人士称强迫婚姻和早婚在北加扎勒河州增多，部分原因是经济状况恶化
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Aweil-based activist Angelina Agau Thiep said forced and early marriages are increasing across Northern Bahr el Ghazal, partly because of worsening economic conditions.

uncertainties: 强迫婚姻和早婚增多的说法来自单一活动人士，尚未获得独立核实
事件仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj），缺乏交叉验证
